headline: Gabriele Fava | the future of pensions and Italian welfare | WATCH
summary: INPS president Gabriele Fava outlined the challenges facing Italy's pension system and welfare. He stressed that population ageing and ongoing reforms will affect future social policy.
why: INPS is Italy's national social security institute, managing pensions and welfare payments for most workers. Its finances shape public spending and fiscal planning.
